data.name: Murdok
data.detailed_description:
A dead soul wakes in ash. A crown calls from the void.

In Murdok, you are a nameless soul resurrected in a dying world choked by the Black Ash. Long ago, twin brothers ruled from the Throne of the Abyss. Consumed by envy, Kodrum betrayed his brother, seized the Crown, and tore open a wound between reality and the Void. Guided by the faint whispers of the fallen king and a mysterious Woman of Mists, you must carve your path through the darklands to claim the throne. But beware: the truth is rarely what it seems.

Will you claim the crown to become the new guardian of the boundary, or shatter it to free every soul the void has stolen?

KEY FEATURES

  • Distinct Classes, With Many More to Come
    Begin with the Necromancer, Cryomancer, Shadeblade, or Amazon. Every class has its own skills, mechanics, and playstyle. Many additional classes are planned for future updates.

  • Five Acts of Escalating Horror
    Journey through 100 levels of corruption. Explore atmospheric, hand-crafted environments, from the volcanic wastes of Ashenfall and festering swamps to the hollow shell of the Corrupted Imperial City and the impossible, screaming geometry of the Nightmare Realm.

  • Clash with Nightmarish Abominations
    Face Kodrum's most terrifying lieutenants. Fight your way through the Blind Butcher, the Flayed Emperor ruling from a throne of peeled skin, the crucified Nailed Angel, and finally, Kodrum himself, no longer a king, but a god of nothingness.

  • Build Skills Your Way
    Develop your attributes and level each skill through use. Socket stackable runes and gems into abilities to add projectiles, summon more minions, spread elemental effects, increase area size, or strengthen defensive powers.

  • A Demanding Endgame
    Completing the five acts is only the beginning. Enter high-level zones, survive dangerous events, challenge powerful bosses, reach level 100, hunt rare runes, and refine specialized builds against the hardest content.

  • A World-Shaping Ultimate Choice
    Your journey ends at the Abyss Throne. Claim the Crown's ultimate power for yourself and police the boundaries of the world, or destroy it forever to release all bound spirits. The fate of the Darklands rests in your hands.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) version 1809 or newer (required for D3D12 compatibility)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3 (Dual-core / Quad-core, 2.5 GHz)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630, NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows / DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (Quad-core / Hexa-core, 3.0 GHz or higher)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon RX 570 (with 2 GB VRAM or higher)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows / DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: None
